entries.evidence_boundary: Images had zero High/Critical scanner findings and deployment preflight passed; formal software admission and license/security owner approval remain absent.

Live discovery/forwarded-header and wrong-Host checks passed.
Live trusted CA/SAN behavior and wrong-CA/hostname rejection passed.

Real browser tokens, public JWKS and distinct kid were checked in a temporary realm. Old token remained valid during overlap, then failed after old provider removal; new token remained valid. No shared realm key or signing private key was changed/read.
Real browser authorization-code flow covered PKCE/state/nonce, wrong verifier, and code replay against a temporary realm.
Password grant rejection was tested; named administrator MFA and bootstrap removal/handover were not completed.

Original real expiration/signature/claim tests were rerun. Added four malformed/oversize/empty/whitespace boundaries: three were rejected locally, one malformed JWT reached the issuer. This is bounded input coverage, not exhaustive parser proof.
Live revocation/session actions were measured against the ten-second new-request denial target.
Real Keycloak issuer+sub mapping, unmapped-subject denial, disabled user/organization, and mapping revoke passed against isolated business DB.
No case permission was inferred from Keycloak admin status; unmapped or unauthorized business identity remained denied.

Nineteen cases passed: fifteen real TLS/socket/database faults with positive real-token controls, plus four token-input boundaries (three rejected locally, one sent to the issuer). Slow-response RED/GREEN evidence is retained. Response progress budget and per-I/O timeouts are verified on these paths, not a universal hard real-time total deadline.
Real temporary client-secret rotation: old adapter rejects with existing 503, new secret verifies the same real token. Original live secret tests retained. Not a formal secret custody handover.
A service restart followed by persistence and readiness revalidation was not performed in this acceptance batch.
Configured secret/dependency scan passed, but complete runtime-log, hosted-CI, and full-history credential review for this exact commit is not complete.
Encrypted backup restored into a new network-isolated database volume; counts 2 realms, 16 clients, 1 synthetic user; original DB unchanged. This is not production DR acceptance.
Production restore/cutover session invalidation and old-token/client-secret rejection were not exercised.
No production rollback/cutover was performed; the isolated restore did not modify the live identity service.
Current committed-payload hosted CI and artifact verification are pending; local 225 scoped, 342 unit, 246 business and quality checks passed but do not substitute hosted execution.
